verdict.rationale: The only calendar-related evidence is a changelog note that external AI apps can use Missive's MCP server to act on your calendar. That implies Missive has a calendar data model, but it describes agent access, not a power-user working in the email client UI. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-app calendar view, responding to invites (RSVP) from within emails, creating events in the client, details of calendar sync with Google/Office 365, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
